title: core.imposter — octahedral imposter atlas descriptor
description: The JSON half of an imposter node; the other half is four PNG atlases per tier. There is deliberately no custom binary here — see spec/layouts/imposter.layout.txt, which also carries the NORMATIVE octahedral encode/decode maths and the G-buffer channel packing. Law 9: the preview tier is simultaneously the store's thumbnail sheet and the runtime's farthest LOD.

tier.description: 'preview' is the small sheet written early in the container; 'runtime' is the in-engine tier.

mapping.description: Which of the two mappings in spec/layouts/imposter.layout.txt section 2 applies. Full covers the sphere; hemi covers only n.y >= 0 and suits ground props.

tile_count.description: N: the atlas is N x N tiles.

tile_pixels.description: T: edge length of one tile.

atlas_pixels.description: [width, height] of each PNG. MUST equal [N*T, N*T]; declared anyway so a reader compares rather than assumes, and can reject a mismatched PNG.

projection.description: Orthographic is the default and the only one that composites correctly across tile blends. Perspective is recorded honestly when a source provided it.

ortho_half_height_m.description: Required when projection is 'orthographic': half the vertical extent of the view volume, metres. Together with the tile being square this fixes the scale exactly.

camera_distance_m.description: Distance from the bake pivot to each tile camera, metres.

pivot_m.description: Model-space point every tile camera aimed at. Normally the core.phys.bounds sphere centre; declared rather than assumed.

depth_min_m.description: Metres corresponding to a depth texel value of 0.

depth_range_m.description: Metres spanned by the full 0..65535 depth range. metres = value/65535 * depth_range_m + depth_min_m. 65535 means 'no surface'.

channels.description: The four G-buffer atlases. Each names a core.tex node (identity, law 4) and mirrors its path.

alpha_is_coverage.description: When true, the albedo alpha channel is surface coverage and a consumer MUST discard texels with alpha 0.

bake.description: How the atlases were produced. Enough to reproduce them, which is what makes the node's input_hash meaningful.

source_node.description: node_id of the geometry that was baked.

lighting.description: 'unlit-albedo' means the albedo atlas holds raw base colour with no lighting, which is the only choice that lets a runtime relight the imposter. Anything else bakes in a light rig and MUST say so.

environment.description: Name of the environment used when lighting is 'baked-environment'.

seed.description: RNG seed, so the bake is reproducible bit-for-bit.

silhouette_iou.description: Mean intersection-over-union of the imposter silhouette against the source mesh, over all tiles.

mean_abs_color_error.description: Mean absolute per-channel error in linear space, over covered texels.

recommended_switch_distance_m.description: Distance beyond which this tier is visually indistinguishable from the mesh at 1080p vertical resolution with a 60 degree vertical field of view.
